The '''Mooga system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mooga/Legends|Mooga]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Corruption" />
